name: Human Resources
description: Lovebugs, Hormone Monsters and a parade of other creatures juggle romance, workplace drama and their human clients' needs in this "Big Mouth" spinoff.

videos.title: Birth
videos.overview: Junior Lovebug Emmy panics when she's assigned her first client: a woman who's about to go into labor. Hormone Monster Maury celebrates a big birthday.

videos.title: Training Day
videos.overview: After one too many romps in the break room, the Hormone Monsters are sent to sensitivity training. Walter takes Emmy on an eye-opening ride-along.

videos.title: Bad Mummies
videos.overview: Emmy struggles to help Becca bond with her baby, the Shame Wizard tries to impress his mom, and Connie takes care of Maury's little fellas for a day.

videos.title: Rutgers is for Lovers
videos.overview: Rochelle and Petra clash over whether client Nadja should pick a college based on love or ambition. Logic Rock Pete learns his office nickname.

videos.title: Love in the Time of Postpartum
videos.overview: Becca's return to work stirs up confusing emotions, sparking a showdown between her creatures and Barry's. Connie and Maury set Sonya up on a date.

videos.title: The Addiction Angel
videos.overview: As Pete and Rochelle help Doug prep for his wedding, Addiction Angel Dante throws a wrench in the plans. Joe and Gil steal one of Maury's top clients.

videos.title: International Creature Convention
videos.overview: Betrayals, romantic declarations and twisted schemes abound at a raucous creature convention in the skies over North Korea.

videos.title: The Light
videos.overview: While Maury and friends cheer on a cockfight in the back of the bar, Sonya reveals the torrid, star-crossed story behind her firing.

videos.title: It's Almost Over
videos.overview: As Yara's health declines, Walter and Pete scramble to fend off Keith from Grief. The feud between Emmy and Rochelle boils over at the office.

videos.title: Shitstorm
videos.overview: A monster hurricane forces Emmy, Rochelle and their clients to take shelter together. Meanwhile, the main office loses power — and its portals to Earth.

videos.title: The Jizz Mitzvah
videos.overview: At Montel's coming-of-age ceremony, the young Hormone Monster decides to do things their own way. Lovebug Emmy's new client doesn't believe in love.

videos.title: The Tell-Tale Dick
videos.overview: Gavin's identical twin brother, Guyvin, unsettles Lionel the Shame Wizard. Logic Rock Pete wants to tell Rochelle how he feels. Hope comes for a visit.

videos.title: Total RePaul
videos.overview: Dante's severed appendage haunts Pete. Lovebug Walter takes a widowed client on a couples' trip. Gil and Joe exterminate Emmy's crabs — for a bagel.

videos.title: A League of Their Hormone
videos.overview: The Shame Wizards play an office softball game against the Hormone Monsters. Emmy oversteps with Sarah — and Van. Rochelle and Pete finally connect.

videos.title: Rochelle, Rochelle
videos.overview: After Pete shares his feelings with Rochelle, Rochelle must decide if she's a Lovebug or a Hate Worm — but her decision may have ripple effects.

videos.title: Paul Me By Your Name
videos.overview: Walter's boyfriend Simon moves in. Paul feels conflicted about dating after his wife's death. Emmy visits the Memory Bank to dig into Sarah's mom issues.

videos.title: Tony: The Life of an Office Cold
videos.overview: When a cold spreads around the office, nearly all the employees get sick. But will those infected stay home and stop the spread... or continue working?

videos.title: Pity Party
videos.overview: Ambition Gremlin Petra helps a young client advocate for himself. Lionel throws a party to compete with Mona. Alice attends a dinner party to see Dev.

videos.title: On the Daughterfront
videos.overview: Paul asks Sarah to pack up her childhood bedroom, but the old house brings up painful memories. Montel tours potential colleges with their parents.

videos.title: Yipee Ki-Hate, Motherf**ker
videos.overview: At the office holiday party, the Hate Department shows up uninvited. Can Rochelle be the hero her friends need, or will her passion for hate "Die Hard"?
